messages.text:
"Make a fun mobile game called \"ADA Dribble Dash\" for kids 8-15 years old, for ADA Basketball Academy.
Endless runner game: A kid basketball player runs automatically, player swipes left/right to dribble, jumps over cones, collects gold basketballs and ADA coins. Game over if hit obstacle 3 times.
Visual style: Bright cartoon, 2D side view, basketball court background, orange ADA jersey.
Features: Daily Mission, coins can be exchanged for ADA jersey skins, leaderboard, share score button to WhatsApp, start screen asks for Kid Name, Age, School, Parent WhatsApp number. Add Indonesian language UI.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable mobile game called “ADA Dribble Dash” for ADA Basketball Academy.

## Requirements
- Bright cartoon 2D basketball-court endless runner; player dribbles by swiping, jumps cones, collects gold basketballs and ADA coins, and loses after three obstacle hits.
- Include Daily Mission, coin-exchangeable ADA jersey skins, leaderboard, WhatsApp score sharing, player intake fields (kid name, age, school, parent WhatsApp), and Indonesian UI.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions. Check screenshots if possible, saving small JPEGs.

## Decisions
- Implemented as a standalone HTML/CSS/JavaScript game with canvas-drawn graphics, localStorage persistence, and Indonesian/English toggle.
- Player data remains on-device; leaderboard is local to the device.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created a single-page game UI and canvas runner with swipe/keyboard movement, jump button, cones, basketball pickups, three-hit game over, score, coins, and animated court.

- Added responsive mobile styling and cartoon visual elements in `index.html`.

- Run syntax/browser checks and save/inspect a current JPEG screenshot.

1. Inspect the end of `index.html` and append missing panel/language/share event handlers plus idle rendering loop.
2. Run JavaScript syntax validation and launch the app in a browser to test form, controls, collision/game-over, mission, skins, leaderboard, and language toggle.
3. Save and inspect a current small JPEG screenshot; fix any issues found.

- `index.html`: Contains the game UI, CSS, and most game logic; the primary file to continue editing.
